description: This file contains test cases for the QwikTemplate class, which is part of a project scaffolding system for Qwik-based applications. It uses pytest for testing project initialization, configuration loading, template content replacement, and post-processing execution. The file includes fixtures to set up mock template directories and configurations, and validates expected outputs and side-effects.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates and cleans up a temporary directory for tests.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Sets up a mock template directory with configuration and source files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a sample ProjectConfig instance for testing.

methods.name: test_qwik_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that template initialization info is correctly retrieved and contains expected commands.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Checks that project initialization creates the correct directory structure and content replacements.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures post-processing scripts are executed and their side effects occur.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests loading project configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Validates that variable placeholders in templates are correctly replaced with project metadata.
